svg.title: AV²: six turns, six release rounds
svg.desc: Each full turn contains the same five exchanges. Six separately bounded releases are shown. Monitoring overlaps with work for subsequent releases.

g.text: AV² / CONTINUOUS DELIVERY AND INDEPENDENT ASSURANCE
One full turn. One release round.
Six different changes travel through the same five exchanges. Neither strand waits for the other to finish.
Earlier releases are still being observed as subsequent changes are proposed, tested and released.
Zoom in: the five cross-links recur inside every turn
Check the current artifact and intended behaviour
Route evidence to the affected revision
Rerun the fix and impacted prior checks
Admit only within authority; monitor and feed back
Ring = one shared release decision per turn. Other crossings are visual only. A held candidate is not a release.
